_comment: One table, read by all four bindings' cache-roots tests (public issue #530), with the expectations of the production generation-2 channel, every binding's default since the lock (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md, "Generation 2 after the lock"): the default root ends in chtypes/v2, an explicit cache directory, from CHTYPES_CACHE or the binding's option, is used through its v2 subroot (spec/abi-v2/docs.md, rule r5, public issue #527), and the built-in system directories end in v2. (Before the lock the table held the dev channel's, v2-dev.) For the same environment and options, CacheRoot and SearchDirs answer the same list. <TMP> is a scratch directory the test makes; <CWD> is the process working directory at the call (a relative directory resolves against it, lexically, so `.` and `..` fold and no symlink is followed: public issue #541). env keys absent from a case are unset. cache_dir null means no explicit directory; system_dirs null means the built-in list and [] none.
